name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
description: Direct income support scheme providing financial assistance to landholding farmer families to help manage agricultural and household expenses.
eligibility: Indian citizen with cultivable agricultural land in the farmer family's name (as per official state land records)
Land must be owned by the farmer, spouse, or minor children
Income tax payers, government employees, and professionals like doctors/CAs are excluded
benefits: Rs. 6,000 per year, paid in 3 equal installments of Rs. 2,000 every 4 months
Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) straight to Aadhaar-linked bank account
Eligibility for Kisan Credit Card (KCC) with subsidised short-term loan interest rates
applicationProcess: Register online at pmkisan.gov.in under 'Farmers Corner', or apply through your nearest Common Service Centre (CSC). Aadhaar-linked bank account and eKYC are mandatory.

name: PMFBY (Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana)
description: Crop insurance scheme protecting farmers against financial loss from crop damage due to natural calamities, pests, and diseases.
eligibility: All farmers growing a notified crop in a notified area, including tenant farmers and sharecroppers with valid tenancy documents
Age 18-70 years with a valid Aadhaar-linked bank account
Registration must be completed before the state's announced cut-off date for the season
benefits: Up to 100% crop loss coverage credited directly to bank account via DBT
Low farmer premium: 2% for Kharif crops, 1.5% for Rabi crops, 5% for commercial/horticultural crops
Government subsidises the remaining premium amount
Covers losses from pre-sowing to post-harvest stages
applicationProcess: Apply online at pmfby.gov.in, or through a Common Service Centre (CSC) or bank branch. Loss must be reported within 72 hours of the damaging event.

name: Krishi Bhagya Yojana
description: Karnataka's flagship rainwater conservation scheme, helping farmers in dryland and drought-prone regions build farm ponds and irrigation infrastructure to stabilise crop yields.
eligibility: Karnataka resident farmers with at least 1 acre of cultivable land
Primarily targeted at dryland districts (North Karnataka, Bayaluseeme) but extended to coastal and Malnad districts too
Farmers who already received subsidy for pump sets/drip irrigation in the last 3 years are not eligible for those specific components again, but can still apply for farm ponds
benefits: 80% subsidy (about Rs. 70,000) for farm pond (Krishi Honda) construction for general category farmers; 90% (about Rs. 80,000) for SC/ST farmers
Up to 50% subsidy for polyhouses, capped at Rs. 15 lakh per acre
Subsidy also covers lift irrigation pumps, diesel motors, and shade nets
Subsidy is back-ended — paid after construction is completed and verified by the Agricultural Officer
applicationProcess: Apply through your nearest Raitha Samparka Kendra (RSK) at the taluk level, or the District Agriculture Office.

name: Krishi Yantra Dhare
description: Lets small and marginal farmers rent modern farm machinery at heavily subsidised rates instead of buying expensive equipment outright.
eligibility: Karnataka resident farmers, especially small and marginal landholders who cannot afford to purchase machinery
benefits: Rent tractors, power tillers, combine harvesters, rotavators, paddy transplanters, seed drills, and sprayers
Rental rates of Rs. 200-2,000 per acre, versus Rs. 3,000-8,000 in the private rental market
Additional 50% discount for SC/ST and women farmers
500+ Custom Hiring Centres (CHCs) across Karnataka
applicationProcess: Book machinery via the Yantra Karnataka mobile app or through your local Raitha Samparka Kendra (RSK).

name: Farm Machinery Subsidy (Tractors, Tillers, Pump Sets)
description: Subsidises the purchase (not just rental) of farm equipment like mini tractors, power tillers, and pump sets for Karnataka farmers, under the broader Krishi Bhagya and Krishi Yantrikarana schemes.
eligibility: Karnataka resident with at least 1 acre of cultivable land and clear, updated land records (RTC)
Must not have already claimed a machinery subsidy from the government in recent years (commonly a 7-year gap requirement, confirm current rule locally)
benefits: General category: up to 50% subsidy on equipment like mini tractors, power tillers, rotavators, weeders, sprayers, diesel/solar pump sets
SC/ST farmers: up to 90% subsidy
Covers micro-irrigation systems and wire fencing components too
applicationProcess: Apply online via the FRUITS portal, or offline at your nearest Raitha Samparka Kendra (RSK) with Aadhaar, land RTC/Pahani, bank passbook copy, photos, and dealer quotation.

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
description: Provides farmers with short-term credit at subsidised interest rates for agricultural and allied expenses, linked to PM-KISAN registration.
eligibility: PM-KISAN registered beneficiaries are automatically eligible to apply
Owner cultivators, tenant farmers, and sharecroppers can apply with appropriate land/tenancy documents
benefits: Short-term loans at subsidised interest rates for crop production and allied agricultural needs
Simplified, faster processing for existing PM-KISAN beneficiaries
applicationProcess: Apply through your bank branch, or via the PM-KISAN portal if already a registered beneficiary.
